verdict.rationale: Riskified returns decision outcomes that cover several of the story's actions: approve/decline on orders, CVV/3DS step-up recommendations via advise, approve/review/decline for policy claims, and allow/notify/challenge on logins. Nothing shows ops users mapping score ranges to those actions or tuning thresholds themselves. Model calibration is described as done by Riskified's analytics team, which points to vendor-set decisions rather than merchant-configurable cutoffs. Missing for 10: exposed risk scores or score ranges, merchant-configurable threshold-to-action mapping, self-service tuning to own risk appetite, and a unified review/3DS action on the order flow.
